description: Put one page of a PDF's recognized text right — a formula Mathpix misread, a broken paragraph, a table. Read the page first with read_pdf_text and pass its 'version' as expected_version: if somebody saved the page since, nothing is written and the answer says the version there is now. 'text' is the page's whole new text, Markdown with $…$ formulas, at most 100,000 characters. It is kept as a new version of the page with its history, as an agent on behalf of the person whose token this is; a person may revert it to the machine's text. An agent never marks a page «checked by a person» — that is a person's word on the screen. Compare with pdf_page_image of the same page before writing. Requires permission to edit the wiki page the file is on.

expected_version.description: The page's 'version' as read_pdf_text gave it.

filename.description: The PDF's name on that page.

page.description: The page of the original, from 1.

pageId.description: Wiki page id, with 'filename', instead of fileId.

name: update_pdf_text
title: Update pdf text
